title: P3 remove global workspace pointer implementation approach
summary: Removing state.workspace/state.overlay entirely. overlayFor becomes a pure per-workspace Map cache (no alias). Test hooks __setWorkspaceForTest/__setOverlayForTest now seed module-private testWs/testOv + the Map cache (test-only fallback, NOT a production global). decideOne/sweeps require explicit ws; bare-ctx legacy-test path falls to testWs/testOv. Route GET handlers and targetOverlay drop the `|| state.workspace` fallback and hard-400 with {error:"workspace required"} when no ws resolvable. setWorkspace keeps per-session/SSE binding + workspaces.json registration + overlay warm into cache but sets no global; WS_FILE read/write/constant removed. state.graphStore removed — routes resolve graphStore.open(path.join(ws,'.graph')) per resolved ws. The `stWs = T.ws===state.workspace?state:{...state,overlay}` pattern simplifies to {...state,overlay:T.ov}.
